Questions

What is the median annual wage for Graphic designers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Graphic Designers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $65,060.

What is the hourly median for Graphic designers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Graphic Designers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $31.28.

How many Graphic designers work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 1,880 wage-and-salary Graphic Designers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Graphic designers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.14. Values above 1.00 mean Graphic Designers are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Graphic designers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Graphic Designers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $70,170.

How does Austin's Graphic designers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($65,060) is $1,430 lower than Chicago ($66,490) and $11,660 lower than Seattle ($76,720). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
